text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, June 13, 2018 Posted by admin on June 13th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +28 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +5.78 (+0.02%) at 25,322.31.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.43%.
There were 12 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Home Depot (HD) +0.84% and Caterpillar (CAT) +0.76%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Verizon (VZ) -0.99% and Exxon Mobil (XOM) -0.82%.
The Fed ends its two day meeting today with announcement at about 11:00 am PDT and are expected to raise.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down six-tenths of a cent at $2.909 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Apple (AAPL)
Apple (AAPL) is up +13.62% year-to-date.
